segments.name: Completion and Production
segments.description: Provides cementing, stimulation, specialty chemicals, intervention, pressure control, artificial lift, and completion products and services to energy producers.
segments.evidence: Completion and Production delivers cementing, stimulation, specialty chemicals, intervention, pressure control, artificial lift, completion products and services .

segments.name: Drilling and Evaluation
segments.description: Provides field and reservoir modeling, drilling, fluids, evaluation and wellbore placement solutions for customers' well construction activities.
segments.evidence: Drilling and Evaluation provides field and reservoir modeling, drilling, fluids, evaluation and precise wellbore placement solutions that enable customers to model, measure, drill, and optimize their well construction activities.

revenueModel.text: Halliburton earns revenue from selling services and products to energy industry customers, including major, national, and independent oil and natural gas producers.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue during the past three years was derived from the sale of services and products to the energy industry.

changes.text: In 2025, Halliburton decided to sell a portion of its chemical business, expected to be completed in the first half of 2026.
changes.evidence: We have made a strategic decision to market for sale a portion of our chemical business . We expect the sale to be completed in the first half of 2026 .
